entries.feedback: VOX 成片的文字层必须承担三种不同职责：底部字幕精确跟随原旁白；中心判断、反转、关键数字和结论用短花字强调；人物、机构、地点和关键物件出现时，在对应贴纸附近同步显示名称说明。三种文字不能互相替代。

director_defaults.subtitle_policy: Use original narration text with ASR word/sentence timestamps; never distribute caption chunks evenly across a shot.
director_defaults.emphasis_policy: Add concise 2-8 character emphasis cues for central claims, reversals, key numbers and conclusion beats; do not repeat full captions.
director_defaults.entity_label_policy: Label each newly introduced person, institution, place and key object near its corresponding sticker while it is visible.
entity_label_examples: 人物贴纸 -> 真实姓名
director_defaults.generated_text_policy: Render subtitles, emphasis cues and entity labels only in Remotion; keep generated reference images and generated clips text-free.

quality_guardrails: Reject subtitles that visibly lead or lag the spoken phrase.
Reject a main claim, reversal, key number or conclusion with no emphasis cue.
Reject an introduced person or key sticker with no readable nearby label.
Labels must not cover faces, evidence, motion paths or bottom captions.

entries.feedback: VOX 必须成为平行于普通无头口播的独立调查解释线。全片由一个中心问题驱动，用证据地图、历史资料、机制动画、新闻/访谈/现场证据、反证或边界条件逐步收窄答案，最后只给有限结论。

director_defaults.opening_grammar: real_video + animated_title + central_question + evidence_map + data_or_rule_layer + captions
director_defaults.human_anchor_policy: pip_or_split_by_default; fullscreen only when the original statement or lower third is direct evidence
director_defaults.technology_budget: Use maps, timelines, shared elements, depth motion, annotations, and sound bridges only where they clarify evidence.

evidence_guardrails: Generic background footage cannot prove a named event, company, person, policy, price, valuation, or causal claim.
Generated footage may explain mechanisms or bridge scenes but must not impersonate real news, interviews, historical records, or on-site evidence.
A source chart must first appear complete and readable before any detail crop or animated reconstruction.
Contradictory evidence and boundary conditions cannot be removed merely to make the conclusion cleaner.
The final conclusion must state what is known, inferred, conditional, and still unknown.

entries.feedback: VOX 第三条链路不能复用无头口播的卡片轮播。先生成风格板，锁定配色、纸张材质、字体、英雄物件和空间世界；再把口播拆成微分镜。每个微分镜先生成完整 Image2 场景图，再按焦点和景别裁切，导演必须在真实场景图和横方竖裁切接触表上审核；审核通过后才逐镜图生视频，最终由 Remotion 叠加精确文字、数据、图表和证据素材。

director_defaults.image2_scene_policy: one complete scene still per micro-shot; first approved scene locks the world
director_defaults.generated_motion_policy: one approved crop drives one generated shot; Remotion remains the master compositor
director_defaults.chart_policy: physicalize verified data inside the editorial world; do not cut to isolated white dashboards

quality_guardrails: A style board is required before scene image or video generation.
Every approved micro-shot requires a complete Image2 scene still.
Image-to-video cannot start before SOURCE and aspect crops pass director review.
A normal VOX scene cannot hold one large card for the whole narration paragraph.
Generated motion plates cannot impersonate direct evidence.
Generated shot motion must preserve the approved scene subject, material system and spatial layout.
The final composite must visibly differ from explainer_html_video in scene grammar and renderer family.

entries.feedback: 20 秒黄金实测确认：VOX Image2 必须逐镜图生视频，再由 Remotion 加精确标题和字幕。模型原片不能整段照用，要抽查开头、中段、结尾并在后段强光、文字变形或物件漂移前裁切。同一证据世界优先干净切；需要叠化时只让入镜预叠 3-4 帧，避免双影，同时保持出镜不透明以消除黑白闪屏。

director_defaults.image_to_video_fallback_model: MiniMax-Hailuo-2.3-Fast when H3 returns TokenPlan/Credit code 2013
director_defaults.generated_clip_policy: trim to the semantic action before late drift or excessive effects; normalize to 1920x1080_30fps
director_defaults.transition_policy: clean match cut by default; otherwise 3-4 incoming prelap frames over an opaque outgoing shot
director_defaults.text_policy: generated paper labels stay blank; exact title, number and caption are fitted and rendered in Remotion

quality_guardrails: Do not use a long dissolve between two detailed evidence tableaux.
Do not accept a title merely because it fits the source still; inspect the final rendered frame with captions present.
Do not keep the late portion of a generated clip when it introduces a flare, new object, mutated text or unstable ending.
Encoded delivery must pass black-frame, white-frame and freeze scans at every scene boundary.

entries.feedback: 真实下载视频叠加动画、互动图表、标题和大纲的分镜效果很好。以后开头优先使用这种复合镜头，扩大真实视频素材池和成片占比，并允许真实视频作为多个类型分镜的连续背景。

director_defaults.continuity_policy: Reuse a coherent footage family across hook, explanation, chapter bridges, calculations, and recap with different time ranges, crops, overlays, and focus states; avoid replaying the same exact shot treatment.
director_defaults.composition_policy: Real video may be fullscreen, split-screen, masked panel, soft background, or evidence-adjacent context while HTML Video and Remotion supply titles, outlines, charts, rules, timelines, numbers, annotations, and captions.
director_defaults.exception_policy: If semantically relevant or publishable footage cannot be obtained, document the search attempts, rights limitation, and substitute route instead of silently falling back to a static title-card opening.

evidence_guardrails: Contextual footage does not prove financial, regulatory, valuation, allocation, or return claims unless the visible frames directly show the claimed fact.
A source chart used as evidence must remain fully readable; do not turn it into an illegible overlay merely to preserve a video background.
Every downloaded clip must retain provenance, time range, local path, intended use, and rights-review status.
Runtime share is a target, not permission to add unrelated footage or repeat one clip mechanically.

source.creator: 神烦老狗
source.title: 一部AI短剧，怎么同时做成多个国家版本？｜OiiOii 一键出海！
source.analysis_note: ~/Desktop/自媒体创作/00_范式学习/视频训练/每日博主自学习/notes/<creator>/<video>/analysis.md

entries.feedback: 产品解释片的节奏不依赖频繁硬切，而依赖同一核心画布中的状态推进。导演应先展示结果，再用机制动画建立心智模型，随后在连续真实界面中完成操作与验证，并补充失败或限制场，避免成片滑向宣传片。

director_defaults.canvas_switch_policy: Only switch the primary canvas when narrative responsibility changes. Within one responsibility, maintain rhythm with card expansion, path growth, local zoom, PIP, shared-element transitions, and UI state progression.
director_defaults.ui_scene_policy: Each screen-recording scene keeps one operation objective and a persistent step marker. PIP must avoid the active control, result area, chart evidence, and captions.
director_defaults.comparison_policy: Before-and-after proof must use the same action moment, similar framing, persistent labels, and at least one complete action cycle.
director_defaults.semantic_motion_policy: Decompose uses separation, copy uses expansion, distribute uses branching, and replace uses shared-element transition. Generic particles or light sweeps cannot substitute for mechanism explanation.
director_defaults.boundary_test_policy: Every product evaluation includes at least one complete evidence scene showing failure, limitation, manual correction, or an inapplicable condition.

director_routing.remotion: Chapter structure, persistent step state, comparison labels, numeric replacement, captions, and evidence-safe composition.
director_routing.html_video: Mechanism diagrams, path growth, branching, card expansion, and interface-adjacent explanatory animation.
director_routing.screen_recording: Continuous real product operation and verifiable output review; do not repeatedly exit and re-enter the interface.
director_routing.ffmpeg: Silence compression, loudness normalization, shot assembly, and final technical quality control.

evidence_guardrails: Do not start a product explainer with menus or feature lists when a recognizable result can be shown first.
Mechanism-animation labels, colors, and step names must match the following real interface demonstration.
Do not compare mismatched source clips as if they were generated under identical conditions.
Keep chart titles, axes, legends, values, and conclusion context fully readable whenever a chart is used as evidence.
A positive demo without a boundary test is incomplete and must fail director review.

entries.feedback: 当前生成的视频全部用于学习，不用于商业发布。素材搜索与下载阶段不因版权授权状态中断制作；相比泛化背景视频，应优先寻找与标题和具体论点高度吻合的新闻播报、访谈、历史影像、现场资料和真人出镜内容，以增强可信度与说服力。

director_defaults.selection_policy: Search by the exact title entity, event, person, company, date, and claim before broad topic keywords. Use generic background footage only when direct audiovisual evidence cannot be found or when a short visual bridge is needed.
director_defaults.composition_policy: Direct news, interview, archival, and on-site footage may serve as the primary evidence canvas. Add source labels, dates, speaker identity, quoted keywords, subtitles, timelines, or data overlays without obscuring the recognizable evidence.
director_defaults.credibility_policy: Prefer material whose visible subject directly matches the narration. A visually attractive but weakly related clip must not replace a less polished clip that directly documents the claimed event or speaker.

evidence_guardrails: Noncommercial learning use does not mean the material is licensed; preserve the source URL, creator or publisher, download time, local path, and used time range.
Do not label downloaded footage as authorized, public-domain, or commercially reusable unless that status has been independently verified.
Do not use a generic semiconductor factory, trading screen, city skyline, or office scene as direct proof of a named company, event, interview statement, or financial claim.
When direct footage is unavailable, mark the substitute as contextual rather than evidentiary.
Any future public or commercial publication requires a separate rights review even if the learning render was allowed to proceed.

entries.feedback: 无头口播必须消除逐句结尾和分镜边界闪屏。真人新闻、访谈和人像报道不得默认压在动画图表后方充当背景；优先作为全屏主素材，再进入人物或新闻画面与动画互补的分屏构图。口播稿需要按真人换气、数字落点、反问和结论重新组织，而不是只调整全局语速。

director_defaults.caption_continuity_policy: 相邻字幕间隔不超过0.45秒时，字幕底板持续存在，只替换文字；禁止每条cue单独弹入并在句尾退到透明。只有长停顿、章节开始和整段结束允许150到200毫秒的轻微透明度变化。
director_defaults.scene_transition_policy: 普通分镜使用干净硬切或可见物体的transform过渡。禁止在每个场景头尾统一覆盖黑幕、深色帘幕、白闪或全画布闪光。
director_defaults.background_visibility_policy: 任意一帧至少有一个完全可见的基础画面层。多视频背景切换不得存在所有图层同时透明的窗口；优先每场使用一条连续背景，或用有重叠保护的交叉切换。
director_defaults.human_news_material_policy: 新闻主播、采访人物、真人讲解和带显著人像PIP的报道不得作为被图表覆盖的暗背景。它们优先作为完整全屏证据镜头，其次作为独立PIP或分屏主素材。
direct_evidence_shot_grammar: 真实新闻或访谈先全屏保持4到5秒，保留主体、原始下三分之一和报道语境
随后在约0.4到0.5秒内通过transform缩到右侧或右下约38%的独立面板
HTML动画或动态图表同步缩到左上约55%到60%，两个面板各自承担证据与解释职责
解释完成后真实素材移出画面，动画扩回全屏；全过程不经过黑场

spoken_rhythm_policy.language_policy: 长句拆成完整语义块；数字前先交代口径，数字后补一句解释或结论；反问单独成句；结论使用短句落地。不要把原稿机械加逗号，也不要生成只有序号、连接词、单位或两三个字的独立字幕。
spoken_rhythm_policy.caption_fragment_policy: 合并第一、第二、最后、当然、科技、估值、单位尾巴等超短片段到相邻完整语义字幕；可见正文通常不少于4个汉字或一个完整术语。

director_defaults.flash_qc_policy: 最终成片必须扫描全片单帧亮度脉冲，并单独检查每个字幕结束点前后约7帧和每个分镜边界前后约7帧。发现单帧掉画时必须修复或重渲染，并在同一检测口径下重新扫描到零失败。

director_routing.remotion: 调度真实素材全屏、PIP、分屏面板、字幕连续底板、场景变换和全片进度。
director_routing.html_video: 只承担动画、图表、机制解释和无人物背景；不得把真人新闻当作被覆盖的底层纹理。
director_routing.minimax_cli: 按重写后的语义句和停顿层级生成音频及服务端SRT，推荐速度1.08到1.12。
director_routing.ffmpeg: 响度归一、单帧掉画修复、流检查、联系表和最终封装。

quality_guardrails: 真人全屏阶段不得叠加大面积动画图表遮住面部、原始标题或新闻下三分之一。
分屏阶段人物、动画、字幕必须位于互不冲突的安全区，并保留清晰主次。
字幕底板逐句弹入退出、统一压黑转场、背景全透明窗口，任一出现都必须阻断发布。
硬切允许亮度发生持续变化，但不允许只出现一帧黑底或白底后立即恢复。

entries.feedback: 画面中央有主播或主持人的新闻类素材默认直接使用画中画，不先全屏，也不得作为压暗背景。全画布动态背景优先选择工厂、市场、社会场景、风景、人群、采访环境等可感知的真实空间。背景亮度和遮罩要让观众明确感到画面在运动。新技术只用于少量关键镜头，服务于层级、证据和节奏，而不是全片炫技。

director_defaults.human_anchor_fullscreen_exception: 仅当人物原始发言、新闻下三分之一或现场语境本身就是当前核心证据，且需要完整阅读时，才允许先全屏；普通中央主播、主持人串场、演播室播报默认直接PIP。
director_defaults.background_visibility_policy: 动态背景需肉眼可感知。默认视频亮度约0.68到0.76，避免大面积黑色遮罩高于约0.82；暗角和投影只承担分层，不得把背景压成近似静态黑底。具体数值按素材曝光调整，并以字幕和图表可读性为上限。
director_defaults.pip_composition_policy: PIP优先放在右侧或右下安全区，避开主标题、数据落点和字幕；人物与动画各自承担不同叙事职责。PIP可使用0.45到0.6秒弹入、轻微悬浮和克制轮廓光，但不得连续多镜头重复。
director_defaults.selective_new_technology_policy: 新Skill或新动效先在开场、章节转折或核心数据镜头中试用，每条片控制在少量关键镜头。优先使用分阶段时间线、深度层移动、聚光轮廓和共享元素过渡；禁止把同一种高存在感特效铺满全片。

director_routing.remotion: 负责PIP-only调度、安全区、轮廓光、轻悬浮、共享元素和无黑场退出。
director_routing.html_video: 负责持续可见的场景类真实背景、标题、图表和机制动画；不得将中央主播嵌入背景层。
director_routing.gsap_or_shotcraft: 只在少量关键镜头做分阶段时间线、聚光层级或深度移动。
director_routing.ffmpeg: 检查背景可见度、单帧亮度脉冲、人物遮挡和最终封装。

quality_guardrails: 中央主播先全屏再缩小不再是默认语法；若无证据阅读需求，必须直接PIP。
人物素材不得被低透明度压在大面积图表后方。
背景不能因亮度过低、遮罩过黑或阴影过重而失去动态感。
新技术使用数量服从叙事，不得造成全片节奏同质化或视觉疲劳。
